summary: Wellgistics Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the withdrawal of its preliminary proxy statement on Schedule 14A, previously filed May 14, 2026, related to a special meeting of stockholders. The company stated it will not proceed with the proxy materials in current form as it continues to evaluate potential strategic transactions. No definitive proxy materials were distributed. This indicates the issuer is conducting a strategic review, possibly exploring alternatives such as a sale, merger, or restructuring. No deal terms, advisor, or timeline were disclosed. Watch for revised proxy filing or announcement of a specific strategic transaction.
